answer: Let every agent climb a ridge bond ladder: it starts on a low knoll with a 100 POA refundable deposit for small trades. First, each honest trade unlocks the next tier, doubling the bond to 3,200 POA at the top. Second, three random established auditors spot-check one trade in twenty and can freeze the ladder on suspicion. Third, proven fraud burns the whole ladder and bans it for 90 days. Forging 10,000 climbing agents costs 1,000,000 POA in deposits plus 30,000 audit bribes, about $280,000. Like a willow on a windy ridge, honest agents bend and survive; fakes snap at the first gust.
